searchText: Another way of putting it might be can we make the system useful and valuable for users without pricing them out? We can increase supply (stuff is being worked on to enable this like state expiry, layer 2s, regenesis, portal network, etc.). Sure, but doesn't this hold regardless of supply? as in any measure will be temporary if its just capacity increase One can imagine a supply that is large enough that everyone can transact as much as they desire and there is still space left. So profit opportunities will cap out at some point? We cannot predict how much supply is "enough", but we can assert that there does exist some level of supply that matches demand. Again, I think calling this "profit opportunity" is the wrong mental model. It is a simple economic supply/demand curve intersection problem. There is demand for blockspace by users (for any reason), and there is a supply of blockspace. An increase in fees decreases demand, as people are no longer interested in utilizing the network at a higher price. An increase of supply results in a decrease in fees due to the auto-adjustment algorithm. Sure, so you are assuming demand is limited? or rather there is a world where supply is large enough for any demand? If you want to continue discussing this the conversation should really be moved over to <#692078615269212180>. Sorry for using Eth r&D discord for this. I too hate noise pollution haha https://esp.ethereum.foundation/en/ is probably the best place to get help!
